section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for Study 1, which consisted of two subsamples from Poland. The first subsample (N=336, 171 women, M age=34.95) was used for factor analysis of the BAS-2, while the second subsample (N=385, 212 women, M age=35.38) was used to examine model fit and measurement invariance. All participants were Polish and White, with BMI assessed via self-reported weight and height (M=24.31 and M=23.91 for subsamples 1 and 2, respectively).
